workloads.scenario: Prebuilt clean launch, first request, warm restart; missing dependency diagnostic
workloads.oracle: No user-machine theory build; ready event precedes commands

workloads.scenario: Leaves of Grass/Pride and Prejudice authors; ambiguous bridge; unknown favourite singer
workloads.oracle: Pinned corpus coverage; ambiguity/unknown retained; positive relation is not completeness

workloads.scenario: 2+3*4; sqrt(x^2) negative x; 0/0; x^2<1/100; spring force/energy/zero stiffness
workloads.oracle: Exact result/domain refusal with interpretation and unit assumptions

workloads.scenario: Absent relation, uniqueness, rank/count, missing page, truncation, stale snapshot
workloads.oracle: Closed coverage licenses negative/aggregate; partial source never licenses universal absence

workloads.scenario: One source answers, another times out; cancellation during routed request
workloads.oracle: Preserve component scopes/blockers; no global success from one positive witness
2^n state count reported before allocation; cap output rows at 1024, reject/paginate excess

workloads.scenario: Continuous sensor polling during foreground search and source update
workloads.oracle: Freshness uses event time; no per-poll theory/code build; compare foreground-alone latency

workloads.scenario: Concurrent state revisions, retry, crash before/after durable ack, cancellation in flight
workloads.oracle: At-most-one accepted revision; unknown dispatched effect retained; no false cancellation success

workloads.scenario: Baseline/candidate evaluation, interception, abstention, interrupted effectful evaluation
workloads.oracle: Independent request/session namespaces; no changed normal request before/after; abort spends exposure

workloads.scenario: Edit/import, diagnostics, impact traversal, proof export, render paginated results
workloads.oracle: Changed dependencies invalidate consumers; UI preserves scoped claims and bounds visible output

workloads.scenario: Exercise every growth tier with overlapping pinned old/new generations
workloads.oracle: Counters show no rebuild for observations/plans; compile only executable tier; stale handles reject
